CURRENT_STATE_C0.rolling_1h: last 12 closed 5m buckets; None if any missing; consensus range/move = median over venues; volume = cross-venue sum
CURRENT_STATE_C0.reference: rolling-1h value at every present 5m bucket in [t-30d, t), weekday types pooled; percentile core timeframe 1h window 30d
CURRENT_STATE_C0.maturity: Stage-2 confidence tiers by span: none<3d, low<7d, building<30d, mature>=30d; gate uses mature only
CURRENT_STATE_C0.gate: MIN_EXTREME_METRICS = 2 of 3 and venues agreeing with the median move sign >= min_venue_coverage = 2
CURRENT_STATE_C0.false_alert_surface: gate qualification per hour (drives push text, /catchup and briefing eligibility); delivery suppression does not change eligibility
CURRENT_STATE_C0.presentation_baseline_out_of_scope: BETA_HORIZON_TOD_V2 same-UTC-time +-30min median over 30 prior days, mature 20 days, pooled weekday types; descriptive only

CANDIDATE_C1_PRIMARY.reference: same 30d lookback restricted to present buckets whose window end is on a UTC date of the same weekday type as t
CANDIDATE_C1_PRIMARY.weekday_type_rule: UTC date of the window end; Sat/Sun = WEEKEND
CANDIDATE_C1_PRIMARY.rationale: minimal change to the current construction; tests the found calibration problem without changing the horizon

SECONDARY_C1_LONG.role: sensitivity only; cannot decide; may become primary only by a written amendment before any Stage H count

COUNTING_UNIT: non-overlapping hourly windows with usable ranks; 5m-step rates reported beside

GUARDRAIL_CELLS.rv_tercile: trailing-30d realized volatility tercile; edges fixed from Stage H and carried unchanged

METRICS.primary: P_S = max over WEEKDAY/WEEKEND and metrics of |G_S|
METRICS.qualified_rate: U_S(s); guardrails only; venue agreement NOT_EVALUABLE on the Stage H proxy

STAGE_H.label: HISTORICAL / EXPOSED / PROXY EVALUATION
STAGE_H.classification: whole surface historically exposed for this decision (R03 published weekend-vs-weekday differences on it); no historical holdout exists or is created
can: direction and rough size of calibration error

STAGE_P.label: PROSPECTIVE / CONFIRMATORY
STAGE_P.data: beta state tape schema V2, after the start bucket
STAGE_P.start_rule: first UTC 00:00 bucket at which both C0 and C1 have usable weekend and weekday ranks (mature tier; C1 also 8 same-type dates), determined mechanically from counts; calendar expectation only: late October 2026
STAGE_P.stop_rule: first UTC Monday 00:00 at which both primary strata meet the requirement; hard cap 26 weeks after start -> INCONCLUSIVE
STAGE_P.blinded: counts only before the stop (usable hours, dates, missing share, episode counts); one analysis at the stop
STAGE_P.no_tuning_after_H: only a written amendment before Stage P starts (new design version) or a restart on later data under a new preregistration

SURFACE_2025_2026.window: 2025-01-01..2026-08-15 exclusive, six Binance USD-M symbols, 1m klines + bookDepth + OI metrics
SURFACE_2025_2026.statistics_known_from_records: swing-low episodes, arm outcomes, 22-feature covariate comparison incl. log RV24, ATR%, 7-day return; no weekday/weekend, hour-of-day or unusual-hour calibration statistic recorded
SURFACE_2025_2026.product_side: D7 regime backfill 90d and 30d bootstrap read Binance 1m from about 2026-07; no weekday statistics derived
SURFACE_2025_2026.admissible_role: none now; at most an additional EXPOSED sensitivity slice by owner decision; never confirmatory

DECISION_RULE.H_SUPPORTS_PROSPECTIVE: P_C1 <= P_C0 - 0.01, assessable guardrails hold, min N met
DECISION_RULE.H_REFUTES: P_C1 > P_C0 + 0.005 or a guardrail breached -> C1 closed
DECISION_RULE.P_PASS: min N met; |G_C1| <= 0.02 in both primary strata for all metrics; P_C1 <= P_C0 on the same hours; all guardrails hold
DECISION_RULE.P_FAIL: any guardrail breached, or |G_C1| > 0.03, or P_C1 > P_C0 + 0.005
DECISION_RULE.P_INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise or min N unmet at the hard cap
DECISION_RULE.PRODUCT: PASS iff H_SUPPORTS_PROSPECTIVE and P_PASS (a proposal under PRODUCT_FIRST_DECISION_V1 section 11, not a change); FAIL iff H_REFUTES or P_FAIL; else INCONCLUSIVE

STOP_CONDITIONS: product rule / cut / venue minimum / context version / tape schema change during Stage P
gate absent from main at Stage P start
any pre-stop read of a Stage P rate (stage void)
NO_LOOKAHEAD: ranks at t use buckets strictly before t
weekday type of a sample from its own window end
tercile edges from Stage H only
Stage P read once at the count-defined stop
no evaluation-period data sets a threshold
FORBIDDEN_DATA: opened 2025-01..2026-08-15 surface unless the owner decides otherwise (sensitivity only)
R03 unit files and results as inputs
PREREQUISITES: offline evaluator with PIT, weekday-type and counts-only tests; no product code change
freeze of thresholds/start/stop/terciles before Stage P; owner Stage P activation and opening
